entries.name: 8259 interrupt ctrl
entries.description: Programmable interrupt controller: eight prioritised interrupt request inputs, masked and acknowledged under software control, that can be cascaded to a second controller.
entries.behaviour: Two registers selected by one address bit. Writes to the first are command words told apart by bits 4 and 3, and writes to the second are the next initialization word or the interrupt mask.

sources.cites: OCW1 sets and clears the mask bits in the interrupt
